description: This file is a shell script for testing Git's pathspec attributes, specifically testing the behavior of Git commands with various pathspec magic strings related to attributes (attr). It sets up test repositories, configures attributes, and verifies expected Git command behavior with these attribute-based pathspecs.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands and checks for successful exit.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting failure, runs the commands and verifies they fail.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output of a command is empty.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern in the output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual output with expected output.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
